correctness.rationale: For r<=m-2, every rooted walk of depth r at either corner-neighbor stays within the rectangle even when interpreted in the infinite quadrant; coordinate swap gives an exact rooted unfolding-tree isomorphism. For adjacency A and degree deficit b=4-deg, quadrant-symmetric defect moments cancel, while at k=m-2 a unique straight walk from (1,0) reaches the short far side, giving a difference of exactly +1. Round k+1 colors determine A^k b; hence the first split is round m-1. The standard C2-counting unary-color equivalence gives the rank statement. Direct simulation independently checked 204 finite cases; the infinite claim follows from the argument, not the simulation.

value.rationale: The exact delay is a structural quantifier-rank/locality threshold for a canonical and highly symmetric graph family, not a routine recomputation of an arbitrary small graph invariant. Two geometrically perpendicular corner-neighbours of a nonsquare grid cannot be told apart for m-2 rounds; a single boundary walk produces the first possible distinction on round m-1. The forced linear-in-short-side stabilization lower bound gives a parameter-sharp obstruction for anonymous local refinement and a precise pointed C² expressive-depth benchmark.
